items.t: IVT check engine light with transmission codes
items.job: Diagnose codes and update transmission control software
items.note: If the IVT must be replaced, Hyundai's powertrain warranty usually covers it for the original owner; out of warranty it costs several thousand dollars.

items.t: IVT check engine light from oil pressure sensor
items.note: Usually covered by warranty on these model years.

items.t: Front seat belt pretensioner can burst (recall)
items.job: Install pretensioner cap or replace pretensioner (recall)

items.t: EGR valve short can cut engine power (recall)

items.note: Covered under warranty on most of these cars.

items.t: Key-start Venues are easy to steal
items.job: Anti-theft software update and steering wheel lock
items.note: The update is free at Hyundai dealers.

items.job: Diagnose stalling and update engine software
items.note: Cost depends on what the dealer finds; usually covered under warranty.

items.t: Moisture or fog inside headlights or taillights
items.job: Replace leaking headlight or taillight assembly
items.note: Normal condensation needs no repair; a leaking lamp is usually replaced under warranty.

items.t: Apple CarPlay or Android Auto drops out
items.note: You can often install the update yourself for free.

items.t: Radio app crashes or false 'Uneven road ahead' message
Screen or instrument display goes black
items.job: Software update; replace display if needed

items.t: Door lock settings won't stay set
items.job: Body control module diagnosis and software update
